verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a game engine editor, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party natural-language or AI command interface. The runtime probe confirms there is no official MCP server. The community MCP servers (e.g. Coding-Solo/godot-mcp, hi-godot/godot-ai) are third-party workarounds outside Godot's own distribution. The CLI, headless mode, EditorScript, plugins, and the built-in LSP are developer building blocks rather than an NL capability, so none of them earn credit here.
